node.title: Re^3: perlcritic and heredocs
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Like [choroba], I also can't reproduce those two policy warnings here either, with versions 1.134 and the latest 1.138. What version of [mod://Perl::Critic] do you have installed? (perlcritic --version) And do you perhaps have any other Perl::Critic::* add-ons installed?
